cv2_policy: historical comparator only; excluded from module construction and all network definitions
eigengene_sign_rule: orient PC1 so its correlation with the per-sample mean standardized module expression is nonnegative

missing_data_policy.cin_pairwise: exact Pearson using pairwise finite overlap; require >=80% of cancer samples and >=20 overlapping samples
missing_data_policy.cout: correlate complete eigengene with each eligible outside gene using that gene's finite samples and the same overlap threshold
missing_data_policy.gene_eligibility: >=95% finite within cancer and >=20 finite samples, with nonzero finite variance
missing_data_policy.pca_eigengene: z-score finite cells within gene; impute remaining standardized missing cells to 0 (within-gene mean) only for SVD/eigengene
missing_data_policy.provenance: frozen 2026-08-29 after Stage A1 halted at the nonfinite guard and before any network point estimate was produced
missing_data_policy.source_nonfinite: preserve as missing; never convert to zero-expression

module_policy.reason: externally defined, compact, low-redundancy biological-state/process signatures unrelated to historical GRI gene selection

network_primitives.Cin_pairwise: median absolute Pearson correlation among mapped module genes within cancer type
network_primitives.Cin_pc1: fraction of standardized module variance explained by first principal component
network_primitives.Cout: median absolute Pearson correlation between the oriented module eigengene and eligible genes outside that module but inside the same externally frozen Hallmark gene-set universe within cancer type
network_primitives.Cout_scope: Hallmark-union background; not the full transcriptome and not claimed equivalent to canonical DNB PCCout

purpose: map static transcriptomic organization without defining chi or a fixed organization optimum
transform_for_network: log2(max(expression,0)+1) for finite source cells; non-finite cells remain missing

uncertainty.note: development stability diagnostic only; no promotion p-value
